record.original_question: In the same setting of a polynomial diffeomorphism of C^2 with an invariant interior component U and limiting map g: U -> C^2, suppose g has a fixed point in U and rank one, so that g is a retraction onto a Siegel disk. Can g instead be a retraction onto a Herman ring, or onto a punctured Siegel disk?

evidence.quote: Rank One Case. If g has a fixed point in U , then g must be a retraction of U onto a Siegel disk.
Can g be a retraction onto a Herman ring (or onto a punctured Siegel disk)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:\mathbb{C}^2\to\mathbb{C}^2$ be a polynomial diffeomorphism (i.e., a polynomial automorphism of $\mathbb{C}^2$) with positive dynamical degree, and let $U\subset\mathbb{C}^2$ be a periodic Fatou (interior) component which is invariant under $f$. Assume that the family of iterates $\{f^n|_U\}$ is normal, and let $g:U\to\mathbb{C}^2$ be a limit map of a convergent subsequence $f^{n_k}|_U \to g$. Suppose that $g$ has rank one at every point of $U$ (so the image $\Sigma=g(U)$ is a one-dimensional complex submanifold of $U$, and $g$ is a holomorphic retraction $U\to\Sigma$ such that $f|_\Sigma:\Sigma\to\Sigma$ is a conformal automorphism). It is known that if $g$ has a fixed point in $U$, then $\Sigma$ must be a Siegel disk (i.e., $f|_\Sigma$ is conformally conjugate to an irrational rotation of the unit disk).

Question: Can the situation instead occur in which $\Sigma$ is a Herman ring (a doubly connected Riemann surface, conformally an annulus $\{1<|z|<R\}$, on which $f$ acts as an irrational rotation), or in which $\Sigma$ is a punctured Siegel disk (a once-punctured disk on which $f$ acts as an irrational rotation)? Equivalently, determine whether such rank-one limit retractions onto a Herman ring or onto a punctured Siegel disk are possible for polynomial diffeomorphisms of $\mathbb{C}^2$.
artifact.category_tag: Polynomial diffeomorphisms of C^2 / Fatou components
artifact.status_search_result: Searches for results on rank-one limit retractions of invariant Fatou components of polynomial diffeomorphisms of $\mathbb{C}^2$ onto Herman rings or punctured Siegel disks did not turn up a definitive resolution. The classification of recurrent Fatou components by Bedford–Smillie (and subsequent work) treats Siegel-disk retractions, but the existence/nonexistence of Herman-ring or punctured-Siegel-disk retractions in this dissipative-automorphism setting does not appear to have been settled in the literature located.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of Polynomial Automorphisms of C^2 (Bedford lecture notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses invariant Fatou components, their rank (one or two), and limit retractions onto Siegel-disk-like submanifolds.
status_evidence.claim: The rank-one case of recurrent Fatou components is studied; Siegel-disk retractions are the established model, but Herman-ring or punctured-Siegel-disk variants are not asserted to occur or to be excluded.

status_evidence.title: Polynomial Diffeomorphisms of C^2: VI. Connectivity of J
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational paper on Fatou components of polynomial diffeomorphisms of C^2.
status_evidence.claim: No statement located resolving whether rank-one limit retractions onto Herman rings or punctured Siegel disks can occur.
